answer: A workable design: chain each registration to a per-identity nonce derived from the prior epoch hash so clones collide. Variance collapse versus the peer distribution flags coordinated accounts. Because it works by making the twenty-first clone cost more than the first twenty combined, cluster rewards are paid once, not per address. The network ties the nebula to sunk effort, uses the meadow as an corroborating signal, then requires a prism before any payout.
